## The Architecture 🗺️

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
**Two layers:**

- **Posit** (your IDE)
- **Databricks** (SQL warehouse + Healthcare data)

Posit queries live Databricks. No data movement.
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
```
┌─────────────────────┐
│   POSITRON IDE      │  ← You
│ + Posit Assistant   │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │ SQL query
           ↓ result set
┌─────────────────────┐
│  DATABRICKS         │
│  SQL Warehouse      │
│  + Healthcare data         │
│  + Unity Catalog    │
└─────────────────────┘
```
:::
::::

# PHASE 1: Connectivity

---

## Step 1 — Get Your Databricks Workspace 🚀

**Sign up:** [databricks.com/learn/free-edition](https://www.databricks.com/learn/free-edition)

**Find your HOST:**
- Look at your browser URL
- Copy everything up to `.com` (e.g., `dbc-xxxx.cloud.databricks.com`)
- Save as **DATABRICKS_HOST**

::: footer
Databricks + Posit Workshop
:::

---

## Step 1b — Find Your SQL Warehouse & HTTP Path 🏭

**In Databricks UI:**

1. Click **SQL Warehouses** on the left
2. Click your active warehouse
3. Click **Connection details**
4. Copy the **HTTP Path** (e.g., `/sql/1.0/warehouses/xxxxxxxx`)
5. Save as **DATABRICKS_HTTP_PATH**

<div class="tip-box">
💡 Warehouse "Stopped"? Click **Start** (waits ~30 seconds).
</div>

::: footer
Databricks + Posit Workshop
:::

---

## Step 2 — Generate Your Access Token (PAT) 🔐

**In Databricks UI:**

1. Click your **user profile** (top right)
2. Click **Settings** → **Developer**
3. Click **Manage** next to **Access tokens**
4. Click **Generate new token**
5. **Copy immediately** — Databricks never shows it again

<div class="warning-box">
⚠️ **CRITICAL:** Do not lose this token.
</div>

::: footer
Databricks + Posit Workshop
:::

## Setup: Install Packages & Create .env 📦

**Open me (Posit Assistant, bottom-left chat icon)**

**Tell me:**

> "Install these packages via pip: databricks-sql-connector, polars, plotly, shiny, streamlit, python-dotenv, nbformat, nbclient, nbconvert, ipykernel. Then create a .env file in my project root with fields: DATABRICKS_HOST, DATABRICKS_HTTP_PATH, DATABRICKS_TOKEN, QUARTO_PYTHON=.venv/bin/python (leave the values blank — I'll fill them in)."

**I'll create the `.env` file for you with the template.**

**Then: Fill in your actual credentials** (from Steps 1–2):
- `DATABRICKS_HOST` = your workspace URL
- `DATABRICKS_HTTP_PATH` = from SQL Warehouse connection details
- `DATABRICKS_TOKEN` = your Personal Access Token (from Step 2)
- `QUARTO_PYTHON=.venv/bin/python` (leave as is)

**Save the file. Your credentials are now secure in `.env`. I'll reference them when I write code.**

::: footer
Databricks + Posit Workshop
:::

## Understanding the Data Workflow 🔄

**What you just built has three phases:**

```yaml
# PHASE 1: Setup (connection verified)
import polars as pl
from databricks import sql
conn = sql.connect(...)  # ✓ Working

# PHASE 2: Load data (synthetic or real)
query = """SELECT * FROM (VALUES ...)"""
df = pl.DataFrame(...)

# PHASE 3: Explore (ask me for analysis)
# Add aggregations, filters, charts
# Everything uses 'df' as the source
```

**Why this matters:**

The DataFrame `df` is your contract. Dashboard, Shiny, and Streamlit will all read from it. Change the query once, every downstream output updates automatically.

::: footer
Databricks + Posit Workshop
:::

# Reference Material

---

## Comparing the Frameworks 🔍

| | **Quarto Report** | **Quarto Dashboard** | **Shiny** | **Streamlit** |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Output** | HTML/PDF | HTML | Web app | Web app |
| **Interactivity** | Static | Static + Plotly | Fully reactive | Fully reactive |
| **Server needed?** | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| **Best for** | Exec reports | KPI monitoring | Internal tools | What-if tools |
| **Deploy to** | Email | Posit Connect | Posit Connect | Posit Connect |

<div class="tip-box">
💡 Start with Quarto reports to build trust, graduate to Shiny for operational teams, Streamlit for planning conversations.
</div>

::: footer
Databricks + Posit Workshop
:::

## Unity Catalog Governance 🛡️

**Every query is audited at the Databricks layer.**

```python
query = """
SELECT grantee, privilege_type, table_name
FROM system.information_schema.table_privileges
WHERE table_catalog != 'system'
"""
df_governance = query_databricks(query)
```

**Key point:** Row-level and column-level security are enforced **inside Databricks**. Your Posit apps inherit this automatically—no way to bypass data access controls.

<div class="step-box">
✅ This is why Healthcare organisations trust Posit + Databricks for patient data.
</div>

::: footer
Databricks Unity Catalog · Data Governance & Security
:::

## Troubleshooting Checklist ✅

**Ask me first** — I can usually fix issues and regenerate code.

**If you want to troubleshoot manually:**

- [ ] `.env` file in project root with all three credentials filled in?
- [ ] `QUARTO_PYTHON=.venv/bin/python` set?
- [ ] Python interpreter set to `.venv` (top-right)?
- [ ] All packages installed? (`pip list | grep databricks-sql-connector`)
- [ ] Databricks warehouse running?
